title: Ion subscription lookup response, version 1
description: The body a subscriptionLookup endpoint returns with HTTP 200 to a request carrying Ion-Subscription-Lookup-Version: 1. An empty array means the caller has no subscription.

id.description: Stable identifier. Ion remembers the operator's choice by this value, so it must not change when the key rotates. Unique within one response.

label.description: Display name shown when the operator chooses between subscriptions.

key.description: The subscription key Ion applies to the configured provider.
